notes: N-14 (filed January 8, 2021, proposed effective February 8, 2021 under Rule 488) by Managed Portfolio Series, an open-end trust, for the reorganization of Delaware U.S. Growth Fund (open-end series of Delaware Group Adviser Funds) into Jackson Square Large-Cap Growth Fund (series of Managed Portfolio Series); open-end reorganization, so kind=merger with fund_type=open_end_fund. Share-class mapping: Class A, C, R -> Investor Class; Institutional -> Institutional; R6 -> IS Class. security_class 'common' stands for the funds' shares of beneficial interest (all classes); the enum has no better fit. No tickers printed. Expected close: the Q&A says 'on or around April 16, 2021' while the letter and Plan summary bracket the day ('April [16], 2021'). Meeting date March 23, 2021 per letter, notice and summary; the Proxy Statement/Prospectus cover once says 'March 23, 2020' (apparent typo). Record date January 29, 2021. The Plan's outside date is blank ('on or before [...]'), so termination_date is null. Reorganization costs borne by JSP and DMC, not the funds; the Target Fund is the accounting survivor. n_targets=1 read from the single Target Fund, not a stated count.
